elements_selected.content:
Implement git source format parsing in src/theme.rs per REQ-014-006, REQ-014-007.

Create a ThemeSource struct (not to be confused with .zetl-source.toml — this is the parsed install source):

```rust
pub struct ThemeInstallSource {
    pub url: String,            // Resolved git URL
    pub git_ref: Option<String>, // Branch, tag, or SHA
    pub path: Option<String>,   // Subdirectory within repo
}
```

Public API:
  - parse_install_source(source: &str) -> Result<ThemeInstallSource>
    Parses the source string and resolves:
    - 'user/repo' -> https://github.com/user/repo.git (exactly one slash, no protocol)
    - 'user/repo#v2.0' -> same URL + ref='v2.0'
    - 'https://...' -> used directly, extract #ref if present
    - 'git@...' -> used directly, extract #ref if present
    Reject anything that doesn't match these patterns.

  - sanitize_theme_name(raw: &str) -> String
    Lowercase, replace non-alphanumeric with hyphens, strip leading/trailing hyphens.
    Used for deriving a name from a repo URL when no --name or manifest name.

  - resolve_theme_name(name_flag: Option<&str>, manifest: Option<&ThemeManifest>, path: Option<&str>, source: &ThemeInstallSource) -> Result<String>
    Precedence per REQ-014-009:
    1. --name flag
    2. manifest.theme.name
    3. Last component of --path
    4. Repo name from URL
    Validate result with validate_theme_name().
